description.zh:
APN对应的运营商。取值：

- **telecom**：中国电信。

- **mobile**：中国移动。

- **unicom**：中国联通。
description.en:
The carrier corresponding to the APN. Valid values:  

- **telecom**: China Telecom.  

- **mobile**: China Mobile.  

- **unicom**: China Unicom.

description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值：**1**~**50**。默认值：**10**。
description.en: The number of entries to return per page when performing a paginated query. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default Value: **10**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的**NextToken**值。
description.en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:  

- Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.  

- If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the **NextToken** value returned by the previous API call.

description.zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.  

You can obtain the region ID by invoking the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) API.

description.zh:
云连接器实例的版本，不同版本有不同功能限制和计费策略。取值：

- **Basic**：基础版。

- **Standard**：标准版。

<props="china">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请[提交工单](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today)申请。</props>

<props="intl">云连接器实例默认创建标准版，如果需要创建基础版实例，请[提交工单](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex)申请</props>
description.en:
The edition of the cloud connector instance. Different editions have different feature limitations and billing policies. Valid values:  

- **Basic**: Basic Edition.  

- **Standard**: Standard Edition.  

<props="china">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. If you need to create a Basic Edition instance, [submit a ticket](https://selfservice.console.aliyun.com/ticket/category/ga/today) to request approval.</props>  

<props="intl">By default, cloud connector instances are created as Standard Edition. If you need to create a Basic Edition instance, [submit a ticket](https://workorder-intl.console.aliyun.com/?spm=5176.11182188.console-base-top.dworkorder.18ae4882n3v6ZW#/ticket/createIndex) to request approval.</props>
